records.title: OTora: A Unified Red Teaming Framework for Reasoning-Level Denial-of-Service in LLM Agents
records.reason: OTora constructs reasoning-level denial-of-service attacks against LLM agents and measures attack effectiveness/cost. It studies adversarial degradation, not an efficiency improvement; operational implications are security-focused.

records.title: Navigating by Old Maps: The Pitfalls of Static Mechanistic Localization in LLM Post-Training
records.reason: 主題は学習エージェント/安全/ドメイン固有応用などで、LLM推論の計算量・メモリ・遅延・スループット・量子化・serving改善に具体的に結び付かない。

records.title: Using large language models for embodied planning introduces systematic safety risks
records.reason: 主題は学習エージェント/安全/ドメイン固有応用などで、LLM推論の計算量・メモリ・遅延・スループット・量子化・serving改善に具体的に結び付かない。

records.title: Inference Cost Attacks for Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
records.reason: The paper develops adversarial retrieval inputs that inflate RAG inference cost and evaluates token/compute amplification. It is an attack analysis rather than a cost-reduction or serving optimization; defenses are the relevant future work.

records.title: Evolution of Video Generative Foundations
records.reason: This is a review of video-generation foundation models and discusses diffusion/flow methods and inference challenges. It synthesizes prior methods rather than introducing or evaluating a direct LLM serving improvement; scope is video generation.
